sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 200. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Activates Vital Strike (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Serenity for 60 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
Only [Divine Sword's Maiden] Miyazuhime can be used as Unlocking Potential material
